# Hypothesis census (compiler-derived)

Generated by `scripts/census_run.py` + `scripts/census_build.py` from the
elaborated types of every headline row and every main-text result's backing
declaration. Each binder is listed with its type; structure-typed binders are
expanded through their fields two levels deep, with a frontier list for what
is not expanded; predicate-typed binders and fields are unfolded one level;
the substantive project predicates are printed once in the glossary.

**Columns.** *Storage* is mechanical (baseline structure / family field /
certificate field / theorem binder). *Role* is a regex suggestion from the rule
table at the end, printed as a suggestion. *Scope* is a heuristic reading of the
quantifier prefix. *Status* is asserted only where a reviewed row asserts it
(the curated tables at the end); every other `Prop` row is **unreviewed**.
No status is inferred from a name.

Source commit ``, toolchain `leanprover/lean4:v4.29.1`;
rendering `pp.fullNames true`, `pp.deepTerms true`, `pp.maxSteps 1000000`,
`pp.proofs false` (the same policy as the snapshot fence).

Separate quantities, not one "hypothesis count" (doc 70, C-2):

|---|---|---|
| root declarations | 278 | distinct declarations probed (65 headline rows, 243 manuscript-backing, overlap removed) |
| top-level parameter occurrences | 1949 | every binder of every root, implicit and instance binders included |
| top-level logical premises | 1101 | the `Prop`-typed binders among them |
| expanded field occurrences, level 1 | 13762 (of which `Prop`: 8263) | every field of every structure-typed binder, per root |
| expanded field occurrences, level 2 | 27 (of which `Prop`: 20) | fields of a level-1 field whose type is a project structure |
| logical occurrences (premises + `Prop` fields, both levels) | 9384 | every `Prop`-typed binder and field, containers included |
| expanded `Prop`-valued structure containers | 14 | `Prop`-typed binders whose type is a project structure: counted above, expanded into their fields, and given no role or status of their own |
| status-bearing occurrences | 9370 | logical occurrences less the containers; the denominator of the role table and of the reviewed/unreviewed totals (asserted equal) |
| schema identities | 615 | distinct `Prop` fields by DECLARING structure (both levels) plus distinct `Prop` binders by display key |
| unexpanded frontier | 6 | field paths not expanded further, listed per root |

**Bridge to the round-E numbers.** Round E reported 1288 "raw occurrences" and
351 "deduplicated contracts". The first counted `Prop`, structure-typed and
explicit binders plus level-1 `Prop` fields; on this run that rule gives
9796 (the root set changed in round F: see the manuscript roots table).
Its role table summed to 1173 because structure-typed and data binders received
no role; the role table below sums to the status-bearing count (logical
occurrences less the expanded `Prop`-valued containers), which the builder asserts.
The second keyed inherited fields under the subclass that inherited them, so one
schema counted twice; on this run that rule gives 811, against
615 schema identities keyed by the declaring structure (and including
level 2). The display key is the printed type under fixed `pp` options with the
`self`/`p` binders stripped; it is **not** alpha-normalisation — two binders that
differ only in a bound-variable name are two keys.

The four assumption blocks of the model section are carried by certificate
fields rather than by free declarations: `ass:sender` by
`SenderPersistencePackage.sender_IDO_after_target_policy`, `ass:target` by the
Target chord fields of the persistence certificates, `ass:concavity` (stage
strong concavity in `s`) by the placable family's `hCurv`/`q`, from which
`ValueClass2.sender_unique_on` is *derived* on that family (stage A3 is not
itself dynamic argmax uniqueness), and `ass:flip` by the tipping thresholds of
`prop:tipping`.

## Manuscript match

Relation vocabulary (doc 70, C-5): **exact statement** — one declaration states
the result as displayed; **valid specialization** — the declaration is more
general and the manuscript instance is a substitution; **proved composition** —
several declarations carry the conjuncts, listed clause by clause; **incomplete
mapping** / **unreviewed** — not yet checked at clause level. Every relation is a
recorded judgement against the pinned statements, not a mechanical comparison.

| label | relation | clauses → declarations | note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prop:tipping` | exact statement | both thresholds: `target_tipping_threshold, sender_tipping_threshold` | the thresholds are definitions; the proposition states their upper-interval property under `ass:flip` |
| `prop:placable-family` | proved composition | carrier fixed point against defiance: `ChordEconomy.VSstar_fix`; interior response, both channels active: `ChordEconomyRelief.both_channels_active_of_margin` | panel A–F of `app:proofs:placable`; (T6) is the subclass's, not the family's (round A); the value before the rally margin is the Sender's value against full defiance (round F wording); the panel now states the loose-modulus witness `exists_member_response_monotone_not_margin` after (RM), the `n`-interval `rally_softening_interval_iff`, the valuation threshold `lossOffset_iff_v_ge` and the relief maximality `reliefSharp_uniform_iff` (round M, N67/N69/N71 promoted); the discriminant condition `sigV_feasible_iff` is stated in the panel, with the half-clause in Section 4.1 (round N, N73 promoted); the seven derived fields — theorems of the structure since round Q1 (`PlacableEconomyF.derived_fields`; through round P they were fields filled by a raw-data constructor) — are stated in panel C and the data paragraph, with the half-clause on the signs in Section 4.1 (round P, N75 promoted; the fields deleted in round Q1 on the user's Rule-18 word); the activation clause is stated under the stage flip since round Q2 (`both_channels_active_of_margin` takes it as a hypothesis, and the family's field is the stage relief margin `hStageRelief`) |

### `Sanctions.MixedChordBound`

Type: `(ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → Prop`

Body: `fun F M => ∀ ⦃x₁ x₂ s₁ s₂ : ℝ⦄, x₁ ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 → x₂ ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 → s₁ ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 → s₂ ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 → |F x₂ s₂ - F x₁ s₂ - (F x₂ s₁ - F x₁ s₁)| ≤ M * |x₂ - x₁| * |s₂ - s₁|`

### `Sanctions.Semiconcave.JointSemiconcaveOn`

Type: `(ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) → Set ℝ → Set ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → Prop`

Body: `fun Φ X A σ ρ q => ∀ x₁ ∈ X, ∀ x₂ ∈ X, ∀ a₁ ∈ A, ∀ a₂ ∈ A, ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t → t ≤ 1 → t * Φ x₁ a₁ + (1 - t) * Φ x₂ a₂ - Φ (t * x₁ + (1 - t) * x₂) (t * a₁ + (1 - t) * a₂) ≤ t * (1 - t) / 2 * (σ * (x₁ - x₂) ^ 2 + 2 * ρ * |x₁ - x₂| * |a₁ - a₂| - q * (a₁ - a₂) ^ 2)`

### `Sanctions.Semiconcave.SemiconcaveOnSet`

Type: `(ℝ → ℝ) → Set ℝ → ℝ → Prop`

Body: `fun v X c => ∀ x₁ ∈ X, ∀ x₂ ∈ X, ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t → t ≤ 1 → t * v x₁ + (1 - t) * v x₂ - v (t * x₁ + (1 - t) * x₂) ≤ c / 2 * (t * (1 - t) * (x₁ - x₂) ^ 2)`

### `Sanctions.Semiconcave.SemiconvexOnSet`

Type: `(ℝ → ℝ) → Set ℝ → ℝ → Prop`

Body: `fun v X c => ∀ x₁ ∈ X, ∀ x₂ ∈ X, ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t → t ≤ 1 → v (t * x₁ + (1 - t) * x₂) - (t * v x₁ + (1 - t) * v x₂) ≤ c / 2 * (t * (1 - t) * (x₁ - x₂) ^ 2)`

### `Sanctions.Semiconcave.StateChordBandAll`

Type: `(ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ → Prop`

Body: `fun F glo ghi => ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc 0 1, Sanctions.Semiconcave.StateChordBand (fun y => F y s) glo ghi`

### `Sanctions.TransitionChords.CornerStateChord`

Type: `(ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ → Prop`

Body: `fun F glo ghi => ∀ ⦃y₁ y₂ : ℝ⦄, y₁ ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 → y₂ ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 → y₁ ≤ y₂ → glo * (y₂ - y₁) ≤ F y₂ 1 - F y₁ 1 ∧ F y₂ 1 - F y₁ 1 ≤ ghi * (y₂ - y₁)`

### `Sanctions.TransitionChords.SanctionLowerChord`

Type: `(ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → Prop`

Body: `fun F d => ∀ ⦃x s₁ s₂ : ℝ⦄, x ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 → s₁ ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 → s₂ ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 → s₁ ≤ s₂ → d * (s₂ - s₁) ≤ F x s₂ - F x s₁`

### `Sanctions.TransitionChords.SanctionSemiconcave`

Type: `(ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → Prop`

Body: `fun F M => ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc 0 1, Sanctions.Semiconcave.SemiconcaveOnSet (fun s => F x s) (Set.Icc 0 1) M`

### `Sanctions.TransitionChords.SanctionUpperChord`

Type: `(ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → Prop`

Body: `fun F d => ∀ ⦃x s₁ s₂ : ℝ⦄, x ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 → s₁ ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 → s₂ ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 → s₁ ≤ s₂ → F x s₂ - F x s₁ ≤ d * (s₂ - s₁)`

## The classification rule table

Roles are assigned by the first matching rule, applied to the field or binder
name and then to its type, after the owner check for baseline field names on
certificates. A role is a suggestion for the reader; it assigns no status.

| rule (regex) | role |
|---|---|
| `^hU[ST]_` | payoff rate condition (chord economy) — a rate bound on a stage payoff, in place of a functional form (doc 104 §2) |
| `^(δ|β_T|β_S|U_T|U_S|σ|F)(_mem|_continuous|_mono_x|_mono_s|_diag|_isMaxOn_U_S)?$` | baseline environment — a field of `Params` (only when the declaring structure is `Params`/`ShockedParams`; otherwise an operator-row coefficient) |
| `StrictAdjustment` | baseline environment (F5) — the maintained strict-adjustment predicate |
| `^(hbandAll|hSlo|hShi|hFjsc|hFcx|hFmix|hFcs|hglo0|hglo_ghi|hghi1|hdlo0|hdlo_dhi|hMx0|hMm0|hMs0|hMcx0|hMmix0|hMcs0|glo|ghi|dlo|dhi|Mx|Mm|Ms|Mcx|Mmix|Mcs)$` | quantitative regularity (transition chord) — a chord field of a family |
| `Chord|Lipschitz|LipschitzOn|Semiconcave|Semiconvex|semiconcave|semiconvex|StateChordBand|MixedChordBound` | quantitative regularity — a chord / Lipschitz / curvature condition |
| `^(hCurv|hSigV|hInterior|hInt|hInt₁|hInt₂|hSR|hPlacate|hStageRelief|hStage|hflip|hTMargin|hCorner|hmargin|hm₁|hm₂|hrelief|hSC|hTM|hTM₁|hTM₂|hP)$|margin|Margin` | economic margin — an inequality among family constants, a theorem-level margin |
| `^[EpP]₁\.\S+ (=|<|≤) [EpP]₂\.\S+$|^b₁ ≤ b₂$|SameButβT|SameGameButβT` | comparative-static identification — two members compared: a coefficient held equal across them, or the one moved, ordered |
| `^↑one = 1$` | domain / experiment condition — names the top state as an element of S |
| `^Continuous fun xs => F xs\.1 xs\.2$|^∀ \(x : ℝ\), F x x = x$` | baseline environment — continuity or the diagonal of a witness family's transition parameter (F1)/(F4) |
| `^G\.b_J - G\.b_K ≤ 0$|^G\.g_J < 0$` | domain / experiment condition — a sign case of the four-group polity |
| `^z₁₀ ≤ z$` | equilibrium-conditional — the two limits compared are ordered: the Target-only limit lies below the forward-looking one |
| `^c ≤ p\.β_S \* m \* κ$` | economic margin — the obstruction's slope-gain condition: the discounted continuation gain of reaching the top exceeds the stage cost of shading |
| `^(hq|hu₀|hr|hw|hℓ|hn|hv|hSigV0|hδ0|hδ1|hβS0|hβS1|hβT0|hβT1|q|u₀|k|r|w|ℓ|c|n|v|SigV|δ|βS|βT)$` | family coefficient (sign or value) — a coefficient or its sign on a family |
| `affineF` | affine restriction (Rule 22) — pins the transition to the affine law; affine-restricted result |
| `^(h_inv|IsInvariant)$|IsInvariant|h_inv` | certificate / carrier condition — invariance of the value class or basin |
| `StageID|FlipSet|flipSet|Flip` | economic margin (stage flip / ass:flip) — a stage-payoff sign or flip-set condition |
| `L_TS \* L_ST|Schur|schur|hsuff|hL_TS|hL_ST|hβ_S_nn|hβ_T_nn|smear|Continuous \(lead|L_lead` | quantitative regularity (existence route) — a Schur/Perov or shocked-route regularity constant or margin |
| `rally_dom|senderRally_pos|kS_pos|w_pl_nn|^h[a-zA-Z]*(0|1|nn|pos)$|^hqr$|^hk$|^hcn$|^hxb|^hsbar|^hMF0$|^hMstate0$` | family coefficient (sign or value) — a sign, positivity or ordering of a family or microfoundation constant |
| `^0 ≤ |^0 < |< 1$|≤ 1$|^β[₁₂]? < |^\d|^∀ \(t : ℕ\), 0 ≤ ` | domain / experiment condition — a sign or range condition on a scalar parameter |
| `^x ≤ 1 / 4$` | domain / experiment condition — the state range of a statement at the dual-basin economy (states up to 1/4, prop:entrenchment-welfare(i); round D, 2026-10-12) |
| `HawkBounded|WeightBounded` | domain / experiment condition — membership of a welfare completion in a restricted class defined over the completion's own data |
| `IsMaxOn` | equilibrium-conditional — a maximiser hypothesis: the object compared is an actual optimum |
| `carrier|Carrier|isClosed|nonempty|_unique_on|ArgmaxUnique|value_mem|policy_eq|IDO|subpivot|sub_pivot|level|floor|Floor|basin|Basin|Weak|weak|Corner` | certificate / carrier condition — a condition on a value class, carrier or basin |
| `V_S|V_T|α|E\.|FeedbackStackelbergEquilibriumTop|RegimeEquilibrium|rule|Rule|MonotoneOn|ContinuousOn|Monotone ` | equilibrium-conditional — a hypothesis about an equilibrium, its value or its realised rule |
| `∈ (I|S|Set\.Icc|Set\.Ioc|Set\.Ico)|^Filter\.Tendsto u |≤ T|< T|u n|x₀|T$|schedule|episode|Horizon|^xbar|^sbar|^a ≤ b$|^lo <|^xL|^xH|^max xT|^h ≤ 1$|xbar < h` | domain / experiment condition — feasibility of a state, an interval endpoint, an episode length, a schedule |
| `^(hWP|hWQ|hwP|hwQ|hbound)$` | quantitative regularity — a uniform bound on a welfare flow along the compared paths or plans (round W) |
| `^hsep$` | domain / experiment condition — the comparison the rescaling result is about: one group's welfare is higher along the first path by a uniform margin (round W) |
| `^hsoc$` | economic margin — the social marginal return to a sanction is at most eta at every state and compliance (round W, W3) |
| `^hchordW$` | quantitative regularity — an upper chord of zero-sanction welfare in the state (round W, W3) |
| `^(hmonoS|hchordS)$` | quantitative regularity (transition chord) — the transition rises with the sanction, at a rate of at most L (round W, W3) |
| `^hcond$` | economic margin — the planner margin of W3: the first unit of sanction does not pay socially (round W) |
| `^(repS|repT)$` | domain / experiment condition — the representation identity: a government's payoff is the weighted sum of its groups' welfare (round W) |

Fixed statuses (need no review):

| role | status | evidence |
|---|---|---|
| baseline environment | baseline | a field of `Params` (or its restatement on a family) |
| family coefficient (sign or value) | domain (coefficient sign or range) | a sign or range restriction on a family or certificate constant in the declared class; discharged at every member. Its economic reading is reviewed by parameter where it has one (the state valuations `w`, `v` carry their own status); a value outside the range is outside the class, and no prediction is made there. Economic inequalities among coefficients carry their own reviewed row. |
| quantitative regularity (transition chord) | assumption (family chord field) | a chord or curvature bound on the family's transition, beyond continuity and monotonicity; not derivable from `Params`; discharged at `placableAffine`, `placableQuadDiag`, `placableBoundary`, `placableEquality` and the box, and at the symbolic witnesses (`docs/PRIMITIVE-CENSUS.md`) |
| quantitative regularity (existence route) | assumption (existence route; Schur/Perov) | a nonnegative row coefficient or a Schur margin of the joint operator; discharged at the certificate witnesses `qbCertMS_generalF_three_goals`, `lbLow_generalF_three_goals`, `wobbleEconMS_three_goals_full`, `eeCertMS_generalF_three_goals` |
| equilibrium-conditional | conditional on the equilibrium | a property of the equilibrium, value or realised rule the theorem takes as given (invariance of an interval, a fixed point of the closed loop, a floor, monotonicity or continuity of the rule); derived where the equilibrium is constructed (placable family, dual-basin economy) and assumed otherwise |
| economic margin (stage flip / ass:flip) | assumption (stage flip / ass:flip) | a sign condition on the stage payoffs; the manuscript states it as `ass:flip`; the flip sets and thresholds are definitions (`prop:tipping`) |
| certificate coefficient (operator row) | data (certificate coefficient) | an operator-row or cross-row coefficient of the certificate, not the primitive discount; its sign and Schur rows are the existence-route conditions |
| baseline environment (F5) | baseline (maintained) | not implied by (F1)–(F4): `diagonal_and_sanction_monotone_insufficient_for_strict_step`; derived on the families from a positive lower sanction chord: `ChordEconomy.toParams_strictAdjustment` |
| domain / experiment condition | domain | — |
| comparative-static identification | domain (comparative static; ceteris paribus) | the two members compared share every coefficient but the one moved, which is ordered: the definition of the experiment (`prop:target-only`: the rule and the steady state in `r`, round M), not a restriction on either member |
| affine restriction (Rule 22) | assumption (affine-restricted; Rule 22) | the result is affine-restricted and says so; the general-F sibling, where one exists, is named in `docs/PRIMITIVE-CENSUS.md` |

| `Sanctions.Examples.ChordEconomy.hUS_joint` | assumption (payoff rate condition; round AT) | S5 (Lean S6): at full defiance the Sender's stage payoff is jointly semiconcave in state and sanction, with state modulus `σ_x`, cross modulus `r_hi` and sanction modulus `q` — the joint-curvature input to the Riccati closure `σ_V`; a condition on the stage payoff in place of a functional form (doc 104 §2, sign-off M1); not derivable from `Params`; discharged on the whole quadratic–linear family by `PlacableEconomyF.toChord` and at the quartic witness, whose payoffs lie outside the family and whose transition is not affine (`qw_pairs_split`) |

| `Sanctions.Examples.ChordEconomy.hUS_crossLo` | assumption (payoff rate condition; round AT) | S7 (Lean S8): at full defiance the state–sanction cross difference is at least `r_lo` per unit of each — a higher state raises the Sender's marginal value of sanctions at rate at least `r_lo` (the rally complementarity, lower bound; the right side of the rally margin); a condition on the stage payoff in place of a functional form (doc 104 §2, sign-off M1); not derivable from `Params`; discharged on the whole quadratic–linear family by `PlacableEconomyF.toChord` and at the quartic witness, whose payoffs lie outside the family and whose transition is not affine (`qw_pairs_split`) |

| `Sanctions.Examples.ChordEconomy.hUT_stateLo` | assumption (payoff rate condition; round AT) | P3 (Lean T6): the Target's stage payoff rises with the state at rate at least `v_lo + n_lo·s` — the incumbent's stake in entrenchment, rising with the sanction at the rally rate `n_lo`; the numerator of `g_T`; a condition on the stage payoff in place of a functional form (doc 104 §2, sign-off M1); not derivable from `Params`; discharged on the whole quadratic–linear family by `PlacableEconomyF.toChord` and at the quartic witness, whose payoffs lie outside the family and whose transition is not affine (`qw_pairs_split`) |
| `Sanctions.Examples.ChordEconomyRelief.hUT_stateHi` | assumption (payoff rate condition; round AT) | P3 (Lean T7): the Target's stage payoff moves with the state at rate at most `v_hi + n_hi·s` — the upper stake, which enters `L_UT` and the Target's value Lipschitz constant; a condition on the stage payoff in place of a functional form (doc 104 §2, sign-off M1); not derivable from `Params`; discharged on the whole quadratic–linear family by `PlacableEconomyF.toChord` and at the quartic witness, whose payoffs lie outside the family and whose transition is not affine (`qw_pairs_split`) |
